title: Text with a gloss
description: A paragraph with a note in the margin, as scribes glossed manuscripts: on wide windows the note sits in the right margin, level with the text; on narrow ones it follows the text, indented.
instructions: Keep the gloss to one or two sentences: a word explained, a source, an aside. The paragraph must read without it.

props.markdown: Pilots carried a **portolano**, a book of sailing directions from harbour to harbour.
props.gloss: *Portolano*: from the Italian *porto*, harbour. The charts took the name much later.
